# Feed headlines

Add a feed in Reader, then set feed to its saved URL or ID. Fixture preview shows two synthetic headlines. Load saved headlines reads downloaded Reader entries without fetching the feed. Use Reader to refresh the connection or Open Reader to browse it.

Import tool.json through Widgets → Tools; this v2 package installs as a tab in Reader. Legacy v1 definitions remain under Widgets. Author: Open Sesame. License: MIT. Defaults and fixtures are public, synthetic package content. Keep private configuration in the installed instance. See [the authoring guide](../../../docs/tools.md) for validation, creation and submission requirements.
